thread:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — we just saw CompetitorX roll out a latency-optimized routing feature that maps closely to our Dedicated routing ask. Need a quick sync on scope impact and launch gate.
Jon Park: saw it. their UX looks like per-tenant routing + auto-fallback. screenshots? link?
Li-Wei Zhou: https://compx.example/screenshot — basically per-tenant latency tiers + auto-fallback policies.
Samir Patel: we already have routing policy primitives but not tenant-facing controls. building that UI + audit trails is ~3 sprints.
Maya Chen: @Samir can we carve a minimal MVP — expose two toggles: "tenant_routing" and "auto_fallback_priority" and a simple audit log?
Samir Patel: yes for backend hooks it's small. UX + docs + entitlement checks will add time. MVP estimate: 6 weeks assuming no regression.
Emily R: from GTM side, parity messaging will matter. If we ship a shallow control, sales will still ask about SLA guarantees. Need comms plan.
Jon Park: decision trade: fast parity vs deep differentiator (cost-aware routing). Do we prioritize parity to blunt competitor momentum?
Maya Chen: propose runway: 6-week MVP parity (toggles + audit) + parallel spike for cost-aware routing (quantify impact). If spike looks good, next cycle prioritize.
Li-Wei Zhou: technical risk: spread of KV-cache invalidation when routing changes mid-session. Need compatibility tests: \n```\n// test matrix\nsession-affinity: true/false\nmodel-variant: same/compatible\nrouting-change-timestamp: before/after-kv\n```\nMaya Chen: ok add that to QA. Also set launch gate criteria: 1) no KV inconsistency in 95% of test runs, 2) documented tenant API and 3) audit logs surfaced in Console.
Samir Patel: agreed. i'll scope work and push PR to the roadmap epics.
Emily R: i'll draft a one-pager for field + messaging and flag the accounts who will expect parity.
Jon Park: timeline check — 6-week MVP means feature flagged beta by Apr 1 (assuming start next week).
Maya Chen: make it Apr 1 beta target. @product-bot create-epic "tenant-routing-mvp" owner:Samir due:2026-04-01
product-bot: Epic created: tenant-routing-mvp (owner Samir Patel) — /epics/5739
Li-Wei Zhou: i'll own the compatibility tests and add them to CI.
Samir Patel: starting the RFC today, will ping for design review.
Maya Chen: thanks everyone. if blockers pop, post here. :thumbsup:
Jon Park: quick note — capture expected perf delta and cost for customers; sales will ask numbers.
Emily R: noted. i'll coordinate with analytics for estimates.
Maya Chen: end thread.
